        ("wfun", ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_int, POINTER(ctypes.c_double), POINTER(ctypes.c_double))),
        ("psi_deriv", ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_int, POINTER(ctypes.c_double), POINTER(ctypes.c_double)))
    ]
